summary.text: Rob Rolison is a Republican member of the New York State Senate who has represented District 39 since January 2023 and is running for re-election on the Republican and Conservative lines.
He is a former mayor of the City of Poughkeepsie.

paragraphs.text: Rob Rolison was born in Poughkeepsie, New York, where he lives, according to Ballotpedia.
His career includes work in the patrol division of the Town of Poughkeepsie Police Department, service as a member of the Dutchess County Legislature, and a term as mayor of the City of Poughkeepsie.

He took office in the State Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding James Skoufis, and in the 2025 to 2026 session he is ranking member of the Children and Families and the Crime Victims, Crime and Correction committees.
